categories.name: mempool
categories.evidence: The changes only affect block script validation and caching in ConnectBlock and TestBlockValidity, with no changes to mempool acceptance or policy.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Touches src/validation.cpp and src/validation.h, modifying block script verification paths in ConnectBlock and script caching in TestBlockValidity.
categories.rationale: Unifying single- and multi-threaded script verification in ConnectBlock removes a dual-path hazard in consensus code and unblocks batch validation (#29491). It also resolves an inconsistency where multithreaded TestBlockValidity runs silently bypassed script execution cache population.
